scopeNote: integration contract: Pure-Kotlin client conforming to com.google.firebase:firebase-messaging via the Pyric WebSocket bridge and MessagingBroker. Covers per-app FirebaseMessaging singletons and Firebase.messaging KTX extensions, deterministic 142-character :APA91b FCM token minting, deleteToken invalidation and rotation, register/unregister lifecycle flows, local topic validation and MessagingBroker topic/boolean-condition fanout, visible/hidden foregroundMessages and backgroundMessages routing, FirebaseMessagingService delivery callbacks and RemoteMessage decoding, outbound send() with SendException error codes, and RS256 App Check token attachment.
